sentences.en: The tree is tall and strong.
A flower has a sweet smell.
The grass is green in the garden.
A leaf falls from the tree in autumn.
The root of the tree is in the earth.
A seed grows into a plant.
The tree has fruit on its branches.
Plants need sun and water to grow.
sentences.zh: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。

sentences.en: I cut a branch from the tree.
sentences.zh: 我从树上砍下一根树枝。

sentences.en: The wood from this tree is hard.
The flower is red and beautiful.
I grow tomatoes in my garden.
sentences.zh: 我在我的花园里种西红柿。

sentences.en: A berry is a small fruit.
The stem of the plant is thin.
The tree has many branches.
The root of the plant is in the earth.
Grain from the fields is used for making bread.
sentences.zh: 田里的谷物用来做面包。

sentences.en: The leaf of the tree is green.
Each seed grows into a new plant.
sentences.zh: 每一粒种子长成一棵新植物。

sentences.en: A farmer uses a spade to dig the earth.
A plough is used to make the earth ready for planting.
The soil here is fertile. Plants grow well.
sentences.zh: 这里的土壤很肥沃。植物长得好。
